content: We trained models for each label type separately. Word embeddings were initialized to 300d GloVe vectors BIBREF21 trained on common crawl data; these are fine-tuned during training. We used the Adam optimizer BIBREF22 with learning rate and decay set to 0.001 and 0.99, respectively. We used batch sizes of 16.
